stop_register_snapshot.note: GPIO ODR/CCR != measured TB6612 output or brake current

sensor_integration.gyro_interpretation: 20ms sampling of gyro angular rate includes real mechanical vibration; a difference between PWM-on and neutral is not by itself proof of electrical EMI.

phase_findings.limitations: Based on encoder count only; startup is a heuristic at the tested 8-12% settings and 3 repeats. Nonzero post-STOP counts do not establish exact electrical coast/brake mode.

experiment_setup.note: VM state user-supplied, not measured by STM32; duty is not current limit.

electrical_limitation: No current, stall-current, thermal, oscilloscope or physical output-mode measurement. STM32 GPIO=3.3V vs TB6612 VCC=5V outside VIH guarantee; STBY fixed high. 60pct command on high profile is NOT a current limit or electrical safety approval.
interpretation: Sustained_count_signal is an empirical >=5 encoder-count and >=5 tail-count heuristic, NOT a certified deadband threshold.
